▸ EmDash CMS Tutorial: Build Your First Site

💡 EmDash is an open-source, Astro-powered CMS providing real-time, type-safe content management optimized for Cloudflare’s serverless stack.

EmDash is an open-source, Astro-based CMS that leverages TypeScript and sandboxed plugins to provide a secure, passkey-first content management experience. The platform utilizes a decoupled publishing workflow with Portable Text (JSON) and Astro’s Live Content Collections, enabling real-time updates and full type safety through specialized hooks like `getEmDashCollection`. While natively optimized for Cloudflare’s serverless stack (D1, R2, and Workers), it maintains portability for Node.js environments and supports both SQLite and PostgreSQL. This architecture streamlines the developer experience by combining a CLI-driven setup with a direct database-to-render pipeline that eliminates the need for full site rebuilds during content updates.

📝 关键要点 (6 sections)
  • Architecture and Core Features: EmDash is an open-source, Astro-based CMS that replaces PHP with TypeScript and uses sandboxed plugins and structured JSON content. It prioritizes security with passkey-first authentication and offers native integration with Cloudflare’s serverless stack while remaining portable to Node.js.
  • Project Scaffolding: Developers can initialize a project using a CLI tool that configures templates for either Node.js or Cloudflare environments. The setup includes a local SQLite database and generates a critical encryption key for managing plugin secrets.
  • Authentication and Admin Setup: The CMS features a passwordless setup wizard that utilizes WebAuthn for passkey registration as the primary login method. The admin dashboard allows for immediate site configuration and content management without manual database provisioning.
  • Content Management Workflow: EmDash employs a decoupled publishing workflow where drafts and published versions are managed separately in the database, allowing for live updates without site rebuilds. It supports revisions and scheduled publishing through a direct database-to-render pipeline.
  • Data Fetching and Type Safety: The system leverages Astro’s Live Content Collections and specialized hooks like `getEmDashCollection` to fetch content with full TypeScript support. Content is stored as Portable Text (JSON), ensuring it can be rendered across different platforms using a standard UI component.
  • Deployment Strategies: While optimized for Cloudflare Workers, D1, and R2, EmDash can also be deployed to any Node.js server using SQLite or PostgreSQL. Deployment involves using the Wrangler CLI for serverless environments, though local content must be migrated manually to production databases.

▸ How to Install Git on Windows (Step by Step)

💡 Deploy and optimize Git on Windows using winget or manual installers, covering configuration, SSH authentication, and environment maintenance.

Windows developers can deploy Git via `winget` for rapid setup or utilize the manual installer for granular control over PATH configurations, default branch naming, and editor integration. Essential post-installation steps include establishing global identity metadata and configuring SSH-based authentication to facilitate secure, passwordless remote operations. The guide outlines the standard workflow for initializing or cloning repositories while emphasizing long-term maintenance through automated update commands. Finally, it addresses critical architectural considerations, such as resolving PATH conflicts and choosing between native Git for Windows or a WSL-based environment.

📝 关键要点 (7 sections)
  • Winget Installation Method: Use the Windows Package Manager (winget) for a fast, command-line installation that applies sensible default settings automatically.
  • Manual Installer Configuration: Download the official installer to manually customize critical options such as the default text editor, branch naming conventions, and PATH environment variables.
  • Post-Installation Global Config: Configure your global username and email address to ensure all future commits are correctly attributed to your identity.
  • GitHub SSH Authentication: Generate an SSH key and link it to your GitHub account to enable secure, passwordless communication between your local machine and remote repositories.
  • Repository Initialization: Start your development workflow by either cloning an existing project from a remote server or initializing a brand new local repository.
  • Maintenance and Updates: Keep your Git installation current by using built-in update commands or winget to ensure you have the latest features and security patches.
  • Troubleshooting and WSL: Resolve common PATH issues and decide between using Git for Windows or installing Git within the Windows Subsystem for Linux based on your environment.

📰 Terence Eden’s Blog (1 article)

▸ Book Review: When the Dust Settles - Stories of Love, Loss and Hope from an Expert in Disaster by Lucy Easthope ★★★★★

💡 深刻探讨灾难规划中人文关怀与现实挑战的必读之作。

这本书深刻探讨了灾难规划与恢复工作，作者通过结合个人自传与专业分析，强调了在程序化的救援中融入人性化关怀的必要性。书中挑战了防灾领域的性别偏见，并尖锐批判了紧缩政策对国家应急能力的削弱。通过真实且残酷的案例，揭示了现实复杂性如何打破预设方案，是一部理解复杂灾难恢复逻辑的必读佳作。

📝 关键要点 (4 sections)
  • 作者最初对书中过多的个人传记内容感到不适，但随后意识到在灾难规划中融入人文关怀而非仅是冷冰冰的程序至关重要。
  • 书中强调了给予受害者哀悼空间的重要性，反击了对女性参与防灾的性别偏见，并严厉批评了紧缩政策对国家应对创伤能力的损害。
  • 尽管基调沉重且带有黑色幽默，但书中通过具体案例揭示了现实往往让最周密的灾难预案失效，展现了识别受害者的极端难度。
  • 总结认为这是一部关于复杂恢复工作的必读之作，虽然内容沉重且残酷，但对于理解灾难救援的逻辑具有重要价值，给出了五星推荐。

📰 少数派 (1 article)

▸ 一个 05 后的个人数码编年史

💡 A Gen Z developer rejects algorithmic ecosystems for distraction-free hardware, seeking to reclaim open-source digital autonomy.

This digital retrospective maps a Gen Z developer's evolution from early consumer hardware to a critical engagement with device ecosystems, highlighting a preference for E-ink's focus and the high-fidelity hardware of the Surface and MacBook lines. The narrative documents a conscious decoupling from mainstream "doomscrolling" and algorithmic media through experimental, distraction-free hardware like the Fairphone and Minimal Phone. Ultimately, the author frames their pursuit of Computer Science as a reaction against the modern mobile internet’s closed nature, seeking to reclaim the open-source ethos and digital freedom that characterized the early web.

📝 关键要点 (7 sections)
  • Digital Childhood Roots: The author recounts early encounters with an iPod touch and Nokia 106, marking the transition from simple gaming to digital enlightenment via a secondhand Xiaomi 4.
  • E-ink and Literacy: Kindle and the Sony DPT-RP1 are highlighted as pivotal devices that shaped the author's reading habits and aesthetic appreciation for elegant, paper-like technology.
  • Apple Ecosystem Paradox: Despite criticizing Apple's closed nature, the author acknowledges the hardware's superior quality, particularly how the MacBook's screen facilitated a deep dive into world cinema.
  • Microsoft Surface Journey: The author reflects on a loyalty to Surface hardware, valuing its unique design and 'fanciness' despite the practical failures and productivity limitations of devices like the Surface Duo.
  • Niche Hardware Experiments: Frustrated by mainstream distractions, the author transitioned through experimental devices like the Fairphone 5 to the Minimal Phone, using E-ink to successfully cure 'doomscrolling.'
  • Tech Industry Reflections: As a Computer Science student, the author expresses a growing coldness toward modern tech trends while critiquing the negative social impacts of mobile internet and algorithmic media.
  • Internet Utopianism: The narrative concludes with a nostalgic look at the early internet's culture of free resource sharing, which inspired the author's pursuit of computer science and digital freedom.
